resources.string: Chat memory does not work in secret chats.
Chat memory is off. You can turn it on in storage settings.
Only text is kept, not attachments. Chats with content protection and chats with an auto-delete timer are never kept.
Keeps deleted and edited messages on this device. Secret chats are never kept.
Turn off to keep only the chats you chose in their settings.
When memory reaches the limit, the oldest entries go first.
Deleted messages and earlier versions will be erased from this device. Your chats in Telegram will not change.
While chat memory is off, kept messages are not shown, but they are not erased either. Memory is erased when you log out and when you delete an account.
